title: Building and Related Works (Miscellaneous Amendments) Bill
what_it_is: Building and Related Works (Miscellaneous Amendments) Bill

sections.label: ITM digitalisation adoption goals
sections.summary: The ITM aims to raise adoption of digitalisation, automation and prefabrication to make the sector more future-ready and resilient after COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The ITM aims to raise the adoption of digitalisation, automation and prefabrication to position the sector to be more future-ready and resilient, taking in the lessons learnt from COVID-19.

sections.label: CORENET X submission gateways
sections.summary: CORENET X will streamline more than 20 existing agency touchpoints into three submission gateways at design, construction and completion phases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under CORENET X, we will streamline more than 20 existing touchpoints with agencies into just three key submission gateways at the design, construction and occupation and completion phases.

sections.label: BIM approval time reduction
sections.summary: For projects above 5,000 square metres submitted in BIM, approval times could be reduced by 20% to 25% based on preliminary estimates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For a project above 5,000 square metres submitted in BIM, approval times could be reduced by 20% to 25% based on preliminary estimates.

sections.label: Planning Act PP WP split
sections.summary: Clause 25 amends the Planning Act to let QPs apply for and URA approve the PP separately from the WP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Clause 25 will amend the Planning Act to allow QPs to apply for and for URA to approve as the competent authority, the PP separately from the WP.

sections.label: Lodgment harmonisation for lower-risk works
sections.summary: Clauses 2, 4 to 9, 11, 12, 16 to 18 and 20 amend the Building Control Act, EPMA and EPHA for lodgment of building plans under BCA and NEA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Together with CORENET X, all agencies will harmonise their lodgment approach for works of lower risk, such as certain landed housing developments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Hence, clauses 2, 4 to 9, 11, 12, 16 to 18 and 20 will amend the Building Control Act, the Environmental Protection and Management Act, or EPMA, and the Environmental Public Health Act, or EPHA, to provide for lodgment of building plans under Building and Construction Authority (BCA) and National Environment Agency (NEA).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We expect that the response times for lodged projects could decrease from up to seven days for some agencies, to within a day when CORENET X is fully implemented.

sections.label: Electronic service provisions harmonised
sections.summary: Clauses 10, 16, 18, 21, 22, 27 and 28 amend legislation so BCA, NEA, NParks, SCDF and URA can electronically serve approvals and documents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To enable CORENET X, provisions for electronic services will be harmonised under various Acts across agencies for clarity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Hence, clauses 10, 16, 18, 21, 22, 27 and 28 will amend the relevant legislation to make clear that BCA, NEA, National Parks Board (NParks), Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) and URA can electronically serve approvals, directions and other documents related to building works, using a common electronic service system in specified circumstances.

sections.label: Expanded PSG for CORENET X
sections.summary: The Productivity Solutions Grant is expanded to include BIM authoring solutions and training programmes for CORENET X.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To support more SMEs in their upskilling efforts, I am happy to share that we are expanding the scope of the Productivity Solutions Grant, or PSG, to include a package comprising BIM authoring solutions and training programmes to utilise these solutions for CORENET X.

sections.label: CORENET X built environment transformation
sections.summary: CORENET X is not just an IT system but drives digitalisation and collaboration across the built environment project value chain.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: More importantly, CORENET X is not just an IT system but will play an integral role in the ongoing transformation of our built environment sector by driving greater digitalisation and collaboration across the project value chain.

sections.label: New approval and permission provisions
sections.summary: New provisions allow automatic approval of lodgement plans and applications for design certificates, provisional permission and preliminary works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Under the new section 5AA of the BCA, plans for any lodgement works are automatically approved without any need for the Commissioner to check the plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The new section 33E of the EPMA and 46F of the EPHA allow developers to apply for a design certificate to commence preliminary works before getting a clearance certificate for pollution control or public health risks is given.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Under the new section 17A of the Planning Act, there is a process to apply for provisional permission to commence works before planning permission is granted.

sections.label: Legislating environmental impact assessment framework
sections.summary: The third point is the need to legislate an environmental impact assessment framework for all building works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My third and final point is the need to legislate an environmental impact assessment (EIA) framework for all building works.

sections.label: Workplace facilities in 2022
sections.summary: In 2022, there were a total of 46 workplace facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2022, there were a total of 46 workplace facilities.

sections.label: Deaths from workplace incidents
sections.summary: Sixty-six percent of the deaths were caused by workplace incidents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Sixty-six percent of the deaths were caused by workplace incidents.

sections.label: Migrant worker deaths count
sections.summary: The Migrant Worker Death Map records 455 migrant worker deaths between 1 January 2001 and 3 August 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: According to the Migrant Worker Death Map, 455 migrant workers died between 1 January 2001 and 3 August 2022.

sections.label: Japan safety committee rule
sections.summary: Japan's Industrial Safety and Health Act requires employers at worksites with 50 or more employees to set up a safety committee meeting at least monthly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Industrial Safety and Health Act in Japan, for example, obliges employers of work sites with 50 or more employees to establish a safety committee which must meet at least once a month, with half of the members nominated by a representative of the employees.

sections.label: Tender disqualification and director prosecutions
sections.summary: Three stop work orders or major injuries or one death can disqualify a company from tenders for three months, and company directors have not been prosecuted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: A company would have to accumulate three full stop work orders or to have major injuries or the death of one person before there is a disqualification of three months from entering into tenders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: While company directors can be prosecuted under section 48 of the Workplace Safety and Health Act, we have not seen prosecutions of company directors arising from the many workplace safety incidents that have happened, generally speaking.

sections.label: Hot spells and MOM inspections
sections.summary: During hot spells there is generally no Stop Work Order, and MOM conducts targeted inspections on on-site measures and acclimatisation programmes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: During hot spells, there is also, generally speaking, no "Stop Work Order", with companies being able to insist that workers continue to work in temperatures that are much higher than normal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The hon Minister for Manpower shared in May this year that MOM conducts targeted inspections to check on-site measures and acclimatisation programmes for workers.

sections.label: Rest spaces and CORENET X
sections.summary: Construction sites can partner with nearby malls or office buildings for air-conditioned rest spaces, and the Bill gives agencies authority to streamline regulatory processes through CORENET X.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For instance, construction sites can tie up with nearby shopping malls or office buildings to provide air-conditioned spaces for rest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: This Bill gives agencies the authority and means to streamline regulatory processes through CORENET X.

sections.label: 2D submissions versus BIM
sections.summary: MND is asked to clarify whether the built sector can continue making 2D submissions or must move entirely to Building Information Modelling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Two, can MND clarify whether the built sector can continue to make 2D submissions, or will the entire industry be asked to move to Building Information Modelling (BIM)?

sections.label: Staggered BIM and CORENET X adoption
sections.summary: A staggered timeline is needed for industry adoption of BIM and CORENET X while agencies re-engineer processes and prepare CORENET.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: But I believe our agencies also need time to fully re-engineer the process and also to get CORENET functionalities and infrastructure ready especially for industry wide adoption.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Therefore, I believe a staggered timeline is needed to get the industry to adopt BIM and CORENET X.

sections.label: CORENET X approval efficiency potential
sections.summary: MND has great potential to use CORENET X to accelerate approval efficiency by resolving bottlenecks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Four, there is great potential for MND to use CORENET X to accelerate approval efficiency, by resolving bottlenecks.

sections.label: Three key submission gateways
sections.summary: There will be three key submission gateways at the design, construction, and occupation and completion phases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: To recap, there will be three key submission gateways at the design, construction and occupation and completion phases.

sections.label: Agency response times at gateways
sections.summary: Agencies are expected to respond within 20 working days at Design and Construction Gateways, and within seven working days for TOP and CSC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: At the Design and Construction Gateways, agencies are expected to respond within 20 working days for most submissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: At the Occupancy Permit and Statutory Completion Gateway, agencies are expected to respond to applications for Temporary Occupation Permits, or TOP, and Certificates of Statutory Completion, or CSC, within seven working days from the date of their respective inspections.

sections.label: SME co-funding for CORENET X
sections.summary: Local SMEs can receive co-funding support for BIM authoring solutions and CORENET X training under the Productivity Solutions Grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As I had mentioned earlier, local SMEs will be able to receive co-funding support for BIM authoring solutions and training programmes for CORENET X under the Productivity Solutions Grant, or PSG.

sections.label: Consultation for sensitive area projects
sections.summary: Development projects near sensitive areas undergo in-depth consultation with technical agencies on expected environmental impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As part of the planning approval process, development projects near sensitive areas such as Nature Reserves, Nature Areas and other areas with significant biodiversity, marine, and coastal areas undergo in-depth consultation with relevant technical agencies on the expected impact on the environment.

sections.label: EIA framework enhancement study
sections.summary: Projects face existing regulatory standards, and the EIA framework will continue to be studied, including a pilot centralising EIA consultancy services for HDB and JTC projects under NParks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Projects are also subject to existing regulatory standards by various agencies, which developers should be aware of.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, we will continue to study ways to enhance the EIA framework, such as the ongoing pilot to centralise the management of EIA consultancy services for the Housing and Development Board (HDB) and JTC projects under NParks.

sections.label: Multi-Agency Workplace Safety Taskforce setup
sections.summary: Senior Minister of State Zaqy Mohamad earlier mentioned that the Multi-Agency Workplace Safety Taskforce (MAST) was set up in May this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As mentioned by Senior Minister of State Zaqy Mohamad earlier in the reply to the Parliamentary Question, the  Multi-Agency Workplace Safety Taskforce (MAST) was set up in May this year.

sections.label: Bill amendments for CORENET X
sections.summary: The amendments under this Bill are necessary to implement CORENET X, which will deliver significant benefits for the industry and agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The amendments under this Bill are necessary to implement CORENET X, which will deliver significant benefits for the industry and agencies.
